mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id,c.project_id,c.task_id,c.task_revision,c.plan_revision,c.template_version,c.snapshot_id, t.profile_revision,c.content_json,c.content_sha256,v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,c.schema_ref,c.schema_version, c.schema_manifest_sha256,c.created_by,c.created_at,c.classification,p.status FROM plan_content_revision c JOIN plan_revision p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.project_id=c.project_id AND p.task_id=c.task_id AND p.task_revision=c.task_revision AND p.plan_revision=c.plan_revision AND p.template_version=c.template_version AND p.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id AND p.content_sha256=c.content_sha256 AND p.created_by=c.created_by AND p.created_at=c.created_at AND p.classification=c.classification JOIN task_revision t ON t.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND t.project_id=c.project_id AND t.task_id=c.task_id AND t.task_revision=c.task_revision AND t.template_version=c.template_version AND t.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.version_id=c.plan_revision AND v.owner_project_id=c.project_id AND v.entity_kind='PLAN_REVISION' WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.task_id=#{taskId} AND c.plan_revision=#{planRevision} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: JOIN plan_content_revision c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.project_id=r.project_id AND c.plan_revision=r.plan_revision WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.task_id=#{taskId} AND c.plan_revision=#{planRevision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_section(project_id,plan_revision,section_id,template_version,owner_id,goal,requirements,evidence_scope, method,position,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification) VALUES(#{projectId},#{planRevision},#{item.sectionId},#{templateVersion},#{item.ownerId},#{item.goal}, CAST(#{requirements} AS JSON),CAST(#{evidenceScope} AS JSON),#{item.method},#{item.position}, '1.0.0',#{manifest},#{userId},#{now},#{classification})

INSERT INTO research_question(project_id,task_id,question_id,question_key,plan_revision,section_id,question, completion_rule,status,evidence_manifest,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at) VALUES(#{projectId},#{taskId},#{item.questionId},#{item.questionKey},#{planRevision},#{item.sectionId},#{item.question}, CAST(#{completionRules} AS JSON),'OPEN',CAST('[]' AS JSON),'1.0.0',#{manifest},#{userId},#{now},#{classification},1,#{now})
mapper.select:
SELECT task_id,question_id,question_key,question_key_sha256 FROM research_question WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND
question_key_sha256 IN SHA2(#{key},256)
1=0
ORDER BY question_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.section_id AS id,JSON_OBJECT('section_id',r.section_id,'goal',r.goal,'owner_id',r.owner_id, 'method',r.method,'position',r.position,'requirement_node_ids',r.requirements,'evidence_scope',r.evidence_scope, 'template_version',r.template_version) AS content, r.schema_version,r.schema_manifest_sha256,r.created_by,r.created_at,r.classification FROM plan_section r ORDER BY r.position

SELECT CONCAT(r.section_id,':',r.node_id) AS id, JSON_OBJECT('section_id',r.section_id,'node_id',r.node_id,'position',r.position,'template_version',r.template_version) AS content, FROM plan_section_node r ORDER BY r.section_id,r.position
SELECT CONCAT(r.section_id,':',r.rule_id) AS id, JSON_OBJECT('section_id',r.section_id,'rule_id',r.rule_id,'position',r.position) AS content, FROM plan_section_rule r ORDER BY r.section_id,r.position

SELECT CONCAT(r.section_id,':',r.depends_on) AS id, JSON_OBJECT('section_id',r.section_id,'depends_on_section_id',r.depends_on,'position',r.position) AS content, FROM plan_dependency r ORDER BY r.section_id,r.position

SELECT r.question_id AS id,JSON_OBJECT('question_id',r.question_id,'question_key',q.question_key, 'section_id',r.section_id,'question',r.question,'position',r.position) AS content, FROM plan_question r JOIN research_question q ON q.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND q.project_id=r.project_id AND q.task_id=r.task_id AND q.question_id=r.question_id ORDER BY r.position

SELECT CONCAT(r.question_id,':',r.node_id) AS id, JSON_OBJECT('question_id',r.question_id,'node_id',r.node_id,'position',r.position,'section_id',r.section_id) AS content, FROM plan_question_node r ORDER BY r.question_id,r.position

SELECT CONCAT(r.question_id,':',r.rule_id) AS id, JSON_OBJECT('question_id',r.question_id,'rule_id',r.rule_id,'position',r.position) AS content, FROM plan_question_rule r ORDER BY r.question_id,r.position

SELECT CONCAT(r.question_id,':',r.depends_on_question_id) AS id, JSON_OBJECT('question_id',r.question_id,'depends_on_question_id',r.depends_on_question_id,'position',r.position) AS content, FROM plan_question_dependency r ORDER BY r.question_id,r.position
